User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    username = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Animal(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"animals\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    species = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    breed = Column(String)\n    birth_date = Column(Date)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Vaccine(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"vaccines\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    name = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    description = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass MedicalEvent(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"medical_events\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    animal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"animals.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    event_type = Column(String, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"event_type IN ('vaccination', 'medication', 'exam', 'surgery', 'other')\")\n    event_date = Column(Date, nullable=False)\n    notes = Column(String)\n    created_by = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Vaccination(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"vaccinations\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    medical_event_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"medical_events.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), unique=True, nullable=False)\n    vaccine_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"vaccines.id\"), nullable=False)\n    lot_number = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    next_due_date = Column(Date)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Medication(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"medications\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    name = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    description = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass MedicationOrder(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"medication_orders\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    animal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"animals.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    medication_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"medications.id\"), nullable=False)\n    dosage = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    route = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    frequency = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    start_date = Column(Date, nullable=False)\n    end_date = Column(Date, nullable=False)\n    due_date = Column(Date, nullable=False)\n    status = Column(String, default=\"active\", check_constraint=\"status IN ('active', 'completed', 'cancelled')\")\n    notes = Column(String)\n    created_by = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)"

Optional[str] = None\n    email: Optional[str] = None\n    created_at: datetime\n    updated_at: datetime\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)\n\nclass AnimalOut(BaseModel):\n    id: int\n    name: str\n    species: str\n    breed: Optional[str] = None\n    birth_date: Optional[datetime] = None\n    created_at: datetime\n    updated_at: datetime\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)\n\nclass VaccineOut(BaseModel):\n    id: int\n    name: str\n    description: Optional[str] = None\n    created_at: datetime\n    updated_at: datetime\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)\n\nclass MedicalEventOut(BaseModel):\n    id: int\n    animal_id: int\n    event_type: str\n    event_date: datetime\n    notes: Optional[str] = None\n    created_by: int\n    created_at: datetime\n    updated_at: datetime\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)\n\nclass VaccinationOut(BaseModel):\n    id: int\n    medical_event_id: int\n    vaccine_id: int\n    lot_number: str\n    next_due_date: Optional[datetime] = None\n    created_at: datetime\n    updated_at: datetime\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)\n\nclass MedicationOut(BaseModel):\n    id: int\n    name: str\n    description: Optional[str] = None\n    created_at: datetime\n    updated_at: datetime\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)\n\nclass MedicationOrderOut(BaseModel):\n    id: int\n    animal_id: int\n    medication_id: int\n    dosage: str\n    route: str\n    frequency: str\n    start_date: datetime\n    end_date: datetime\n    due_date: datetime\n    status: str\n    notes: Optional[str] = None\n    created_by: int\n    created_at: datetime\n    updated_at: datetime\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)\n\nclass MedicalEventCreate(BaseModel):\n    event_type: str\n    event_date: datetime\n    notes: Optional[str] = None\n    vaccination_details: Optional[dict] = None\n    medication_order: Optional[dict] = None\n\nclass VaccinationAndMedicationCreate(BaseModel):\n    vaccine_name: str\n    lot_number: str\n    event_date: datetime\n    next_due_date: datetime\n    medication_name: str\n    dosage: str\n    route: str\n    frequency: str\n    start_date: datetime\n    end_date: datetime\n    due_date: datetime\n\nclass MedicationOrderCreate(BaseModel):\n    medication_name: str\n    dosage: str\n    route: str\n    frequency: str\n    start_date: datetime\n    end_date: datetime\n    due_date: datetime\n    notes: Optional[str] = None"

      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import MedicalEvent, Vaccination, MedicationOrder, Vaccine, Medication, User, Animal\nfrom schemas import MedicalEventCreate, MedicalEventOut\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nrouter = APIRouter(\n    prefix=\"/api/animals\",\n    tags=[\"MedicalEvents\"]\n)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{animal_id}/medical_events\", operation_id=\"create_medical_event\", response_model=MedicalEventOut)\nasync def create_medical_event(animal_id: int, payload: MedicalEventCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):\n    # Verify animal exists\n    animal = db.query(Animal).filter(Animal.id == animal_id).first()\n    if not animal:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Animal not found\")\n\n    # Create medical event\n    medical_event = MedicalEvent(\n        animal_id=animal_id,\n        event_type=payload.event_type,\n        event_date=payload.event_date,\n        notes=payload.notes,\n        created_by=1,  # Assuming current user is user ID 1\n        created_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n        updated_at=datetime.utcnow()\n    )\n    db.add(medical_event)\n    db.flush()  # Get the ID without committing\n\n    vaccination_id = None\n    medication_order_id = None\n\n    # Handle vaccination details\n    if payload.event_type == \"vaccination\" and payload.vaccination_details:\n        vaccine = db.query(Vaccine).filter(Vaccine.name == payload.vaccination_details[\"vaccine_name\"]).first()\n        if not vaccine:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Vaccine not found\")\n\n        vaccination = Vaccination(\n            medical_event_id=medical_event.id,\n            vaccine_id=vaccine.id,\n            lot_number=payload.vaccination_details[\"lot_number\"],\n            next_due_date=payload.vaccination_details.get(\"next_due_date\"),\n            created_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n            updated_at=datetime.utcnow()\n        )\n        db.add(vaccination)\n        db.flush()\n        vaccination_id = vaccination.id\n\n    # Handle medication order\n    if payload.event_type == \"medication\" and payload.medication_order:\n        medication = db.query(Medication).filter(Medication.name == payload.medication_order[\"medication_name\"]).first()\n        if not medication:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Medication not found\")\n\n        medication_order = MedicationOrder(\n            animal_id=animal_id,\n            medication_id=medication.id,\n            dosage=payload.medication_order[\"dosage\"],\n            route=payload.medication_order[\"route\"],\n            frequency=payload.medication_order[\"frequency\"],\n            start_date=payload.medication_order[\"start_date\"],\n            end_date=payload.medication_order[\"end_date\"],\n            due_date=payload.medication_order[\"due_date\"],\n            status=\"active\",\n            notes=payload.medication_order.get(\"notes\"),\n            created_by=1,  # Assuming current user is user ID 1\n            created_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n            updated_at=datetime.utcnow()\n        )\n        db.add(medication_order)\n        db.flush()\n        medication_order_id = medication_order.id\n\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(medical_event)\n\n    return MedicalEventOut.model_validate(medical_event)"
    },

      "path": "routers/group_002.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import MedicalEvent, Vaccination, MedicationOrder, Vaccine, Medication, User, Animal\nfrom schemas import VaccinationAndMedicationCreate, MedicalEventOut, VaccinationOut, MedicationOrderOut\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nrouter = APIRouter(\n    prefix=\"/api/animals\",\n    tags=[\"Vaccinations\"]\n)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{animal_id}/vaccinations\", operation_id=\"log_vaccination_and_medication\", response_model=dict)\nasync def log_vaccination_and_medication(animal_id: int, payload: VaccinationAndMedicationCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):\n    # Verify animal exists\n    animal = db.query(Animal).filter(Animal.id == animal_id).first()\n    if not animal:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Animal not found\")\n\n    # Find or create vaccine\n    vaccine = db.query(Vaccine).filter(Vaccine.name == payload.vaccine_name).first()\n    if not vaccine:\n        vaccine = Vaccine(\n            name=payload.vaccine_name,\n            description=f\"Vaccine for {payload.vaccine_name}\",\n            created_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n            updated_at=datetime.utcnow()\n        )\n        db.add(vaccine)\n        db.flush()\n\n    # Find or create medication\n    medication = db.query(Medication).filter(Medication.name == payload.medication_name).first()\n    if not medication:\n        medication = Medication(\n            name=payload.medication_name,\n            description=f\"Medication for {payload.medication_name}\",\n            created_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n            updated_at=datetime.utcnow()\n        )\n        db.add(medication)\n        db.flush()\n\n    # Create medical event\n    medical_event = MedicalEvent(\n        animal_id=animal_id,\n        event_type=\"vaccination\",\n        event_date=payload.event_date,\n        notes=\"Vaccination event with medication order\",\n        created_by=1,  # Assuming current user is user ID 1\n        created_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n        updated_at=datetime.utcnow()\n    )\n    db.add(medical_event)\n    db.flush()  # Get the ID without committing\n\n    # Create vaccination record\n    vaccination = Vaccination(\n        medical_event_id=medical_event.id,\n        vaccine_id=vaccine.id,\n        lot_number=payload.lot_number,\n        next_due_date=payload.next_due_date,\n        created_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n        updated_at=datetime.utcnow()\n    )\n    db.add(vaccination)\n    db.flush()\n\n    # Create medication order\n    medication_order = MedicationOrder(\n        animal_id=animal_id,\n        medication_id=medication.id,\n        dosage=payload.dosage,\n        route=payload.route,\n        frequency=payload.frequency,\n        start_date=payload.start_date,\n        end_date=payload.end_date,\n        due_date=payload.due_date,\n        status=\"active\",\n        notes=\"Prescribed medication for vaccination\",\n        created_by=1,  # Assuming current user is user ID 1\n        created_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n        updated_at=datetime.utcnow()\n    )\n    db.add(medication_order)\n    db.flush()\n\n    db.commit()\n\n    return {\n        \"medical_event_id\": medical_event.id,\n        \"vaccination_id\": vaccination.id,\n        \"medication_order_id\": medication_order.id\n    }"
